episode.title: Inside the Hearts of Men and Women

chapters.title: Chapter 3: What Dating Apps Tell Us

episode.tagline: Men and women have always struggled to understand each other — and never more so than in these complex, changing times. What can new forms of data reveal about what we really want?
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay discuss what anonymised search results, dating apps and innovative surveys reveal about what our hearts contain.
